user.title: Add a Steam Machine
user.description: Enter the address of the Steam Machine running the SteamOS HA Decky plugin.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Steam Machine found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Connect to {name} ({model}) at {host}? Make sure it is in Gaming Mode: the pairing code will be shown on screen.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: A 6-digit pairing code is now shown on the TV (and in the SteamOS HA panel of the Quick Access Menu). Enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Steam Machine. Check the address and that the Decky plugin is running.
error.not_in_gaming_mode: The Steam Machine is not in Gaming Mode. Switch to Gaming Mode and try again.
error.wrong_code: That code is not correct. Check the screen and try again.
error.pair_expired: The pairing code expired. A new code is shown on screen.
error.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Check the Decky plugin log.

abort.already_configured: This Steam Machine is already configured.
abort.no_id: Discovered device did not advertise an id.
abort.unsupported_api: The Decky plugin speaks a newer API than this integration. Update the integration.

not_in_gaming_mode.message: The Steam Machine is not in Gaming Mode, so the notification cannot be shown.

notify_failed.message: The notification could not be sent: {error}
